rows.statement: EXCEPTIONS ONLY (operator ruling C1, 2026-10-29). Each check lists in full every name it did not confirm in full — a unit not confirmed, a unit its own rule leaves out, no unit judged, or the check not run on it — exactly as the full card holds it. The names whose every unit is confirmed, and those a check does not apply to, are COUNTED, NOT LISTED: each check's `listing` and `not_listed` say how many. The boundary, the fleet counts and the not-run reasons are the full card's. The full card, every name for every check, was written to `full.path`: git-ignored, it exists only in the checkout that ran the scorecard, and `full.sha256` is the hash of its bytes.

boundary.reads: data/vinci.db, read-only: 2,572,227 bars; 1,236 market sessions 2021-09-01 → 2026-08-05 (+43 partial); latest bar 2026-08-05. Tiingo sample: the 18 names with a committed page (9 more have no bars here); and the 100 names an internal check flags (step_vs_tiingo, zero_volume_vs_tiingo). Tiingo budget 2026-10 (UTC month; 500 distinct symbols a key): 110 looked up this month through this checkout's cache — a floor, since CI, theme intelligence and other checkouts share the key unseen; scoring and the monitor reserve 21 symbols (3 benchmark, 15 followed, 4 ledger), 21 of them held this month; this run asked for 0 the count did not hold; left for the checks: 0 — Tiingo refused a new symbol this run: the key's cap is met, and nothing new is asked until 2026-11-01
boundary.note: reads the git-ignored working store read-only, and Tiingo for the sample; the sha256 names exactly what was read

statuses.confirmed: a second figure agrees within the check's own tolerance
statuses.differs_stated: they differ, and the input states a reason for that unit
statuses.differs_unexplained: they differ, and nothing says why
statuses.unchecked: the unit exists but has no second figure to compare

coverage_classes.independent: a figure from outside the source is compared and a verdict stored
coverage_classes.internal: compared only against the source's own other output — coherence, not correctness
coverage_classes.single_source: no second source exists among this repo's inputs
coverage_classes.unchecked: a second source exists in principle; no structured verdict is stored

failure_classes.wrong_file: another company's export, or another pull of it
failure_classes.wrong_cell: the right file, the wrong row or column
failure_classes.wrong_unit: the right cell, the wrong scale or currency
failure_classes.wrong_period: the right figure for another period, or another vintage of it
failure_classes.different_definition: the same name on a figure built another way

checks.title: Each bar's open and close inside its own high–low range
checks.subject: the stored bar's open, high, low and close
checks.tolerance: exact: 0 < low ≤ open ≤ high, low ≤ close ≤ high, volume ≥ 0. `PriceBar` refuses a high below the low and a non-positive price at write; it does not place the open or the close

checks.title: No close-to-close step by a whole-number ratio
checks.subject: the step from one stored close to the next
checks.tolerance: a step whose ratio, either way up, sits within 3% of a whole number ≥2 differs — the rule that names a corporate action between CIQ panels (freshness.whole_number_ratio). A genuine fall of a half or rise of a double reads the same; the check cannot tell them apart
checks.population: every pair of consecutive stored bars
checks.excluded_rule: steps across a gap of more than 10 market sessions — series_gap judges those

checks.tolerance: a step across more than 10 market sessions with no bar for the name differs (prices.GAP_SESSIONS) — longer than the 10 business days an SEC trading suspension may run
checks.population: every pair of consecutive stored bars

checks.title: The stored close against Tiingo's close for the same session
checks.subject: the stored close (Polygon, adjusted=true: restated for splits only)
checks.second_source: Tiingo's unadjusted close divided by the split factors Tiingo reports after that session — the same splits-only basis
checks.tolerance: within 0.5% of Tiingo's close (prices.CLOSE_TOL — the band freshness.date_of_close accepts as one price)
checks.population: names with a committed page (data/dossiers/*), where TIINGO_API_KEY is set

not_applicable.reason: not in the Tiingo sample — Tiingo is fetched per name, for the names with a page

checks.title: Each flagged step against Tiingo's same two sessions
checks.subject: a step split_shaped_step or series_gap flags: the stored close before it and after it
checks.second_source: Tiingo's unadjusted closes on the same two sessions, times every split factor it reports after the first and up to the second
checks.tolerance: the stored ratio within 0.5% of Tiingo's split-adjusted ratio (prices.CLOSE_TOL) is one move both providers report. Tiingo serving the later session but no row on or before the earlier one differs: the security it carries under the ticker had not begun trading, so the earlier bar is another's. No Tiingo bar for the later session, or for the earlier one inside a series already running, is unchecked
checks.population: every step split_shaped_step or series_gap flags, where TIINGO_API_KEY is set — one request a name, over its flagged sessions (prices.flagged_window)
checks.stated_reason: the stored ratio is Tiingo's UNADJUSTED ratio across a split Tiingo reports between the two sessions: the store holds that split unadjusted

checks.title: One ticker's bars held apart from another security's
checks.subject: a security's stored span of bars
checks.second_source: the spans of every other security in the store carrying the same ticker, on the store's market-session calendar
checks.tolerance: two securities in turn, more than 10 market sessions apart (prices.GAP_SESSIONS), are kept apart. Spans that abut or overlap differ: one history broken across two ids (a re-domicile under a new filer), or two series at once
checks.population: every security whose ticker another security with bars also carries — a former holder whose bars were re-filed off a reused ticker (data/snapshots/ticker_tenure.jsonl) counts as carrying it
checks.stated_reason: the two ids are one line by a recorded rename or re-domicile (data/snapshots/share_class_aliases.jsonl): the successor holds the predecessor's bars before its first session, tagged polygon-alias:<old id>, and the old id is never re-keyed

coverage.carries: the daily close — every return the screens, the monitor and the BUY−AVOID spread read, and each page's spot
unscored: freshness.date_of_close — CIQ's printed comps close matched against the store to DATE the comps panel: it agrees by construction where it matches, a miss is stated only in display text (implied_expectations.tev source_ref), and the printed close is not on the page
eod.client.parse_grouped_daily — the row-COUNT floor at ingest (grouped_daily_min_results): a count, not a value, and it leaves no record in the store
coverage.note: every close is compared with Tiingo's on the page names only; elsewhere Tiingo judges only the steps the internal checks flag, and every other close has the internal checks alone. adjusted=true restates splits, never dividends, so a return read from the store is a price return

coverage.carries: open, high and low — the 52-week range on each page
coverage.note: Tiingo's high and low are not compared

coverage.carries: volume — the liquidity the screens read
coverage.note: Tiingo's volume is compared only where the stored volume is zero; a zero is the only value tested
